app.name: Sunfleck
app.tagline: Plant care for your home and garden

roles.adminDescription: Everything, plus managing the household and its members
roles.gardenerDescription: Add and edit plants, log care

setup.title: Welcome to Sunfleck
setup.intro: Let's create your account. You'll be the Admin of your household and can invite others later.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.noAccount: No account? Ask your household's Admin for an invitation.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link is on its way. No email arriving? Your household's Admin can create a reset link for you.

invite.title: Join {{household}}
invite.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to Sunfleck as a {{role}}. Create your account to get started.
invite.introNoInviter: You've been invited to Sunfleck as a {{role}}. Create your account to get started.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, already used, or expired. Ask your household's Admin for a new one.

home.comingSoon: Your plants will live here. Adding plants, locations, and care schedules is coming in the next milestones.

household.title: Household
household.name: Household name
household.resetLinkHelp: Send this link to {{name}}. It works once, and stops working when they change their password.
household.removeConfirm: Their account will be deleted. Their plants and care history stay in the household.
household.invitationEmailed: We emailed the link to {{email}}. You can also send it yourself:
household.invitationNotEmailed: No email server is set up, so send this link to {{email}} yourself:

errors.email_in_use: Someone already has an account with this email address.

errors.last_admin: A household needs at least one Admin.
